title: Daily or Anytime: what would you like to play?
description: Take on today’s shared challenges or choose a quiz on a favourite topic. A quick guide to finding your next game.

sections.title: Two ways to get started
sections.html:
Want a fresh challenge chosen for you? Head to Daily. Have a particular topic in mind? Browse the Anytime games and pick whatever catches your eye.

You can start playing without an account. If you want to keep your progress across devices, sign in through My Stats. Guest results can also appear in the rankings, under a generated alias.

sections.title: A fresh set of Daily challenges
sections.html:
The Daily page brings together the day’s challenges and shows which ones you have finished. Four scored games contribute up to 2,500 points each to the Daily Brain Score, for a possible total of 10,000.

Brain Mix is a good starting point if you enjoy a variety of questions. After a round, return to Daily to choose another unfinished challenge.

The combined Brain Score is different from an individual game’s raw score. Replays and past challenges can also have different scoring rules, so check the mode label when choosing a round.

sections.title: Follow your interests with Anytime
sections.html:
Try World Flags if you like recognising designs, World Capitals for a geography challenge, or General Knowledge for a bit of everything. Where difficulty levels are available, choose one that feels enjoyable and gives you room to improve.

For a change of pace, explore the word and number games. Each has its own rules; a quick look at the guide can help you settle in before the timer starts.

sections.title: See where a round takes you
sections.html:
Perhaps a flag caught your attention, or an answer reminded you of something you would like to know more about. Follow a related guide, try another topic, or share your result with a friend.

There is no need to turn every mistake into homework. One interesting answer can be enough to bring you back for another round.

sections.title: Come back when you feel like it
sections.html:
You can work through the Daily set, spend a few minutes on a favourite quiz, or leave the next challenge for tomorrow.

BrainiLab+ is optional support for the project. It does not provide extra points, attempts or ranking advantages. The membership page explains the current benefits and advertising status; an upgrade is not required to play.
